subject: Cloud marketplace entry: SKU compatibility, regional variants, and co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Marie Leclerc <marie.leclerc@marketplace-partner.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: nimbus-partner@acmecloud.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 10:13:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: SKU expectations & regional packaging

Hi Ben + Karthik,

Thanks for the intro — excited to explore Redwood in our marketplace. Nimbus Cloud is closing its Q3 intake for new offerings and we need a short checklist from your side to finalize placement and co-sell enablement. Key asks from our ops team:

- Definitive list of SKUs you want listed per cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP)
- Regional availability requirements (we need to know if you can support US, EU, APAC for launch)
- Packaging variants (trial/entry/professional) and whether any variants require different AMIs/container images or license metadata
- Any required security attestations (we already have a SOC 2 baseline but need SAML endpoints, KMS hints)

I've attached an intake template (empty) for you to fill. Could Ben or Karthik share an initial proposal by COB next Tue (11 Aug)? If that's tight, a short bulleted reply with answers to above would be fine.

Cheers,
Marie Leclerc
Partner PM — Nimbus Cloud Marketplace

Attachments: 2026-08-05-nimbus-requirements.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 1 sheet; intake template)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marie Leclerc <marie.leclerc@marketplace-partner.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: SKU expectations & regional packaging

Marie — thanks, sending a quick baseline now and we’ll follow with the completed sheet. High level:

- SKUs by cloud: single catalog model across AWS/Azure/GCP where possible. Proposed entry-level SKU names: Redwood-Start, Redwood-Scale, Redwood-Dedicated.
- Regions: US + EU for initial launch. APAC as follow-on (we can enable in 6–8 weeks pending billing & compliance checks).
- Packaging variants:
  • Redwood-Start: 14-day trial, soft quota, shared-hosting image (no private VPC).
  • Redwood-Scale: reserved capacity option, customer-managed keys optional (KMS integration).
  • Redwood-Dedicated: dedicated pools (reserved), private network enabled — separate product listing requiring extra metadata.
- Security: SOC2 report available; SAML SSO and KMS integration are supported via our Private offering; we’ll provide endpoint docs.

I’ll attach a draft SKU matrix by EOD Friday and assign Karthik to verify the platform constraints for each cloud.

—Ben

Marie / Ben —

Quick tech check after going through the intake:

- For AWS we can keep a single AMI per SKU (shared AMI for Start/Scale; Dedicated requires a private AMI w/ VPC install script).
- For Azure/GCP, container images behind a catalog manifest are preferable; we will publish a manifest for Scale and Dedicated; Start can be SaaS-only (no surface image).
- Latency/regional support: US East + West and EU-West are fully supported. APAC needs a hybrid approach: use GCP APAC regions for inference nodes and a fallback to US for control-plane calls until billing/compliance is cleared.
- Billing metadata differences: GCP marketplace requires usage-export keys; Azure expects a marketplace plan ID. We’ll need Nimbus to provision a marketplace plan ID per SKU.

I’ve attached a first-pass SKU matrix with cloud compatibility flags — feedback welcome.

-Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-08-12-sku-matrix-draft.pdf

From: Marie Leclerc <marie.leclerc@marketplace-partner.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: SKU expectations & regional packaging

Thanks Karthik — that helps a lot. A few clarifying points from Nimbus ops:

- For the Dedicated SKU, we need the exact template for provisioning (AMI + cloud-init or container image + helm chart). Can you confirm the provisioning artifacts will be public in your partner bucket?
- APAC fallback behavior is acceptable for launch but we will flag RTR (routing) limitations in the listing; Nimbus requires a <75ms target for control-plane calls in APAC post-launch — is that realistic if some control-plane traffic routes to US?
- Marketplace listing copy: provide per-SKU bullets for allowed regions and a short note on data residency.

If you can get those provisioning artifacts & a one-page listing draft by Wed (12 Aug), Nimbus can greenlight the listing for Q3 intake.

Best,
Marie

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: SKU expectations & regional packaging

Marie — thanks for the notes, and Nimbus team — appreciate the constraints. Quick consolidated decisions (action items below):

1) SKUs & cloud compatibility (final):
   - Redwood-Start: SaaS-only listing (AWS/Azure/GCP catalog pages) — no AMI/containers. Available US + EU at launch.
   - Redwood-Scale: Container manifest for Azure/GCP; AMI for AWS. Available US + EU at launch; APAC-enabled behind a routing fallback flag (documented).
   - Redwood-Dedicated: Dedicated listing with provisioning artifacts (AMI + cloud-init for AWS, Helm + container for Azure/GCP). Requires Nimbus to create distinct plan IDs.

2) Regional & latency commitments:
   - Launch regions: US (us-east1/us-east-1), EU (europe-west1/eu-west-1). APAC to be opt-in with routing fallback; we will target <75ms control-plane after post-launch optimization (ETA 6 weeks).

3) Security & billing:
   - We will upload SOC2 summary, SAML endpoints doc, and KMS integration notes to the shared Drive.
   - Karthik to provide GCP usage-export instructions; Ben to coordinate Azure plan ID flow with Nimbus PM.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: finalize and upload provisioning artifacts + detailed SKU matrix (due 2026-08-21).
- Ben: draft listing copy for each SKU and provide billing metadata checklist for Nimbus (due 2026-08-20).
- Jonas: review final copy and sign-off on go-to-market messaging (due 2026-08-22).

Marie — are you OK to proceed with the Q3 intake if Karthik/Ben deliver these items on the dates above? We’ll mark APAC as staged in the listing copy.

Thanks — looping Jonas for the final messaging sign-off.

—Ben
